files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Nextcloud 35 support: the manifest now pins majors 34–35. Checked
  against the 35 upgrade notes point by point — the PHP 8.3 server
  floor (the app keeps its own 8.2 floor so 34 installs keep updating),
  Symfony Console 7, the `OCP\DB\Schema` wrapper, the removed front-end
  globals and the removed Remote/preview APIs — nothing the app or the
  card uses was removed, and files_fulltextsearch 35 still fires its
  extension events as `GenericEvent`, so the streaming fast path
  registers exactly as on 34. Both ends of the range pass the
  four-engine integration matrix: 34.0.5 on PHP 8.2 and 35.0.2 on
  PHP 8.3.

### Changed

- The CI's framework checkout falls back to the app's default branch
  while `fulltextsearch` has not cut its `stableNN` branch — it cuts
  its branches after the server cuts its own.
- Every dependency that could move moved: the card's npm set (notably
  `@nextcloud/vue` 9.13 and `vue` 3.5.43) and the dev shell's nixpkgs
  (which still ships PHP 8.2, so the manifest floor stays guarded).
  TypeScript stays 5.9 on purpose: the native 7 no longer exports the
  JS API `vue-tsc` still resolves, and bumping would leave the card
  without a typecheck.
- A second dependency round: `vue` 3.5.44, `vite` 7.3.7, php-scoper
  0.18.20, nixpkgs of 2026-10-15 (PHP 8.2.34), and the CI workflows
  synced with the current Nextcloud templates.
- The value models are `readonly` classes and the services' injected
  dependencies are `readonly` constructor parameters; the last four
  hand-written constructor assignments promote their properties.

### Security

- `composer.lock` was gitignored, so every release resolved afresh: one
  built with a Composer older than 2.9 — which does not skip versions
  with advisories — would have bundled `phpoffice/phpspreadsheet`
  4.5.0, under nine open advisories (phppresentation admits the 4
  line, which has no patched release). The locks are now committed,
  resolved for PHP 8.2; composer.json conflicts with every affected
  version; and CI audits the committed lock and a refresh resolved
  with advisory blocking off.
